title: Japanese museum curator shown UFO footage at Johnson Space Center
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Japanese museum curator shown UFO footage at Johnson Space Center, about unspecified at NASA mission control, Houston, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he was at NASA Johnson Space Center and he said he went to a specific building and they showed him photos of UFOs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a Japanese museum curator, Takano Jouen, who said he visited NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston, home of the space agency's mission control. According to Michels, Takano said he was taken to a particular building and shown photos of UFOs, which would mean NASA keeps such images out of public view.
